tb module "tb"
tb.ff1 module "DFF"
  port input clk
  port input d
  port input rst
  port output q
  path 0: (posedge clk => q) rows [0>0@0.0.0]
  path 1: (rst => q) if (rst == 0) rows [0>0@0.0.1]
  check 0: $setuphold reference edges 0x23 clk data d rows [0.0:first 0.1:second]
  check 1: $width reference edges 0x23 clk rows [0.2:both]
  check 2: $recrem reference edges 0x23 rst data edges 0x23 clk rows [0.3:second 0.4:first]
  check 3: $setup reference edges 0x1c clk if rst data d rows [0.5:first]

  check 2: $recrem reference edges 0x23 rst data edges 0x23 clk rows [1.3:second 1.4:first]

tb.and1 module "AND2"
  port input a
  port input b
  port output y
  path 0: (a => y) rows [0>0@3.0.0]
  path 1: (b => y) rows [0>0@3.0.1]

tb.mux1 module "MUX"
  port input a
  port input b
  port input s
  port output y
  path 0: (a => y) if s rows [0>0@5.0.0]
  path 1: (a => y) if !(s) rows [0>0@5.0.1]
  path 2: (a => y) ifnone rows [0>0@5.0.2]
  path 3: (s, b => y) rows [0>0@5.0.3 1>0@5.0.4]
tb.bus1 module "BUS"
  port input [3:0] a
  port output [3:0] y
  path 0: (a[0] => y[0]) rows [0>0@6.0.0]
  path 1: (a[3:1] => y[3:1]) rows [0>0@6.0.1]
